headline: SEV General Council in the presence of K. Hatzidakis: Productivity, investment and competitiveness in the spotlight
summary: The SEV General Council, held in the presence of Finance Minister K. Hatzidakis, focused on higher productivity, more productive investment and stronger competitiveness. The issues were central to the session.
why: SEV is the Hellenic Federation of Enterprises, the main employers' body in Greece, and its positions shape policy debate on business costs and investment.
